about: The chapter tells how Rome fell to Japheth's line, how a Roman astronomer foresaw the kingship passing to the seed of David, and how King Baltasar of Rome asked Solomon for a son. Solomon, after taking counsel with Israel's elders, sends his younger son Adrami (Ardamis), who is anointed, accompanied by fourteen nobles of Israel, and married to the king's eldest daughter. The part ends with Adrami hearing his first case, a dispute over sheep and a vineyard, which breaks off before the verdict.

The previous part closed the chapter on the Virgin and the Incarnation; this chapter turns to the line of kings of Rome and how it came to Solomon's son.

sentences.i: The kingdom of Rome, for its part, belonged to Japheth, the son of Noah, as his portion and his kingdom;
sentences.n: መንግሥተ is the construct of መንግሥት ‘kingdom’; -ሰ marks contrast (‘as for the kingdom of Rome’). ለያፌት ‘to Japheth’ (ለ- of possession) with ወልደ ኖሕ ‘son-of Noah’ in the construct. ኮነት is the feminine perfect of ኮነ ‘be’, agreeing with ‘kingdom’; ክፍሉ ‘his portion’ and መንግሥቱ ‘his kingdom’ are the predicate. The background is the division of the earth among Noah's sons (Genesis 10): the text does not itself spell out which lands fell to which son. The book comes back to this when it says the kingship will pass to ‘the tribe of Shem’ (unit 9).

sentences.i: While they dwelt they built twelve great cities; and those that are greater than the other cities of their kingdom (?): Darius built Antioch, Dirsia, Bartonia and Rome; and those who reigned would dwell there.
sentences.n: ወእንዘ ይነብሩ ‘and while they dwell’; ገብሩ ‘they made’ (perfect 3mp of ገብረ); ዓሥሩ ወክልኤ ‘ten and two’, twelve (ዓሥሩ I take as the feminine ዐሥሩ, ክልኤ as the feminine ‘two’, agreeing with the feminine plural ‘cities’ (?)); Geʿez puts the smaller number last. The clause ወእለ የዐብያ አህጒረ መንግሥቶሙ is hard: እለ ‘those who’ + የዐብያ, which I read as a verb from ዐበየ ‘be great’; the ending -ያ is the 3fp imperfect (-ā, the cities treated as feminine plural, as in ይነሥኦን ‘them (f.)’, unit 44), so ‘those (cities) which are great’, with አህጒረ መንግሥቶሙ ‘the cities of their kingdom’ in the accusative of comparison or respect: ‘which surpass the (other) cities of their kingdom’ (?). A causative ‘enlarge’ would need አዐበየ. Also አህጉረ above against አህጒረ here, the same word spelled two ways. Names in Bezold's spelling: ዳርዮስ Darius; አንጦክያ Antioch; ዲርስያ and ባርቶንያ I cannot identify (?); ሮምያ is Rome. ይነብሩ ህየ እለ ነግሡ ‘those who reigned dwell there’, an imperfect that I take as continuing or habitual (‘would dwell’).

sentences.i: And Constantinople was built after Christ by King Constantine, in his own name, when the sign of the cross was shown to him in battle, in the likeness of stars written in the sky, and he was also delivered from the hand of his enemy;
sentences.n: The city is ቊስጥንጥንያ and the emperor ቈስጠንጢኖስ, two spellings in one sentence, in Bezold's text. ሐነጸ ‘built’ (perfect 3ms) takes the king as subject; በስሙ ‘in his name’. አስተርአዮ is the ʾastä- stem of ርእየ ‘see’ (‘appear, show oneself’) + ‘him’; the house entry reads ‘it appeared to him’, and with the accusative ትእምርተ it is either ‘he showed him a sign’ or ‘it appeared to him, a sign’ (?); the subject is not named (God or Christ understood (?)), and ትእምርተ መስቀል ‘sign-of cross’ is the thing shown. በውስተ ፀብእ ‘in the midst of battle’. ጽሑፋን is a plural ‘written, inscribed’, agreeing with ከዋክብት ‘stars’. The vision recalls the familiar tradition of Constantine and the cross before a battle; the text itself says only ‘in battle’ and does not name the place (?). The i puts the verb in the passive (‘was shown to him’) because the subject is not stated; the Geʿez verb is active. ወድኅነሂ ‘and he was also saved’ (ድኅነ ‘be saved’); -ሂ ‘too’.

sentences.n: ወውእቱ ዳርዮስ ‘and that Darius’; ኮነ ዘርኡ ብዙኀ ‘his seed was many’ (ብዙኅ ‘many’, here in the accusative). መዋዕለ ‘days-of’ is the construct of መዋዕል. sentences.n: እምዘርአ ዚአሁ ‘from the seed of him’ (ዚአሁ is the independent ‘his’). ተወልደ ‘was born’ (passive). ዘስሙ ‘whose name’ (ዘ- + ስሙ). ዘንበሬስ is Bezold's spelling; I cannot identify the man (?). መጽሐፈ is the construct of መጽሐፍ ‘book’; አስጠሎባ looks like Greek astrolabos, ‘astrolabe’ (?). ረሰየ ‘set, arrange’ takes ከዋክብተ ‘stars’; መዳልወ is the construct of መዳልው ‘balance, measure’, here read as ‘instruments for measuring the sun’ (?). The picture is an astronomer-sage whose learning leads to the next unit.

sentences.i: And he foresaw that the kingdom would not remain with them, with the sons of Japheth, but would pass to the seed of David, of the tribe of Shem.
sentences.n: ወርእየ ‘and he saw’; ዘደኃሪ ‘what is later, the future’ (ዘ- + ደኃሪ ‘last’). The ከመ-clause: ኢትነብር ‘will not remain’ (3fs imperfect, subject መንግሥት ‘kingdom’), ትፈልስ ‘will migrate, move’ (ፈለሰ), with ኀቤሆሙ ‘with them’ and ለደቂቀ ያፌት ‘to the sons-of Japheth’ in apposition. ዘርአ ዳዊት ‘seed-of David’ and ነገደ ሴም ‘tribe-of Shem’ are two constructs. Sem here is Shem the son of Noah, ancestor of Israel (cf. the sons of Noah in unit 3). This is the text's reason why Rome should be joined to David's house.

sentences.i: And when he saw this, he sent to King David and said: Take my daughter for your son;
sentences.n: ወሶበ ‘and when’. ለአከ ‘he sent’ (perfect 3ms of ለአከ); ኀበ ‘to’. ንሣእአ is the imperative ንሣእ ‘take!’ with an extra አ that I cannot account for; this letter has it on many words (ሰላምአ, ሀበኒአ, ወልድከአ, ዘኣነግሥአ, ሮምያአ, ወይእዜኒአ), so it looks like a mark of the text, perhaps a long vowel or an editor's sign; I ignore it in the gloss. ወለትየ ‘my daughter’ (ወለት + -የ ‘my’); ለወልድከ ‘for your son’ (ለ- + ወልድ + -ከ). ‘David’ is named as the recipient although Solomon is the son meant; the story assumes Solomon's father still lives.

sentences.l: and-took-her David king and-gave-(him) to-Solomon his-son;
sentences.i: and King David took her and gave her to Solomon, his son;
sentences.n: ወነሥኣ ‘and he took her’ (-ኣ = ‘her’). ወወሀቦ is ወሀበ + -ኦ ‘him’, a suffix that anticipates the following ለሰሎሞን (‘gave (her), to him, to Solomon’), the same pleonastic pattern as ሤሞ ለአድራሚ (unit 29), ሐተቶ ለቀዳማዊ (unit 47) and እፌንዎ ለአርዳሚስ (unit 21); the object ‘her’ is understood from ወነሥኣ. It is not a slip. ወልዲ is ‘son’ with a final -ዲ in place of -ዱ ‘his’ or -ድየ ‘my’; the same spelling recurs of Adrami (units 29, 37), so I read ‘his son’ and take it as a Bezold spelling (-ዲ for -ዱ; compare ፈቀዲ ‘they wished’ in unit 29). The glossary entry in an earlier part reads ወልዲ as ‘my son’ (-ዲ for -ድየ) (?); here, in third-person narration, ‘his’ is the sense that fits. The house of David is thus joined to the house of Japheth by marriage before Adrami's birth.

sentences.i: And he had a son by her and named him Adrami.
sentences.n: ወለደ ‘he begot’ with እምኔሃ ‘from her’; ወሰመዮ ‘and named him’ (ሰመየ + -ዮ). The name is አድራሚ here; unit 21 gives አርዳሚስ for the same son, and the two forms stand side by side in Bezold's text. I keep Bezold's spelling in l and use ‘Adrami’ in i; for the other spelling I give ‘Ardamis’. The son is Solomon's son by the daughter of the Roman sage (the text does not call her a princess), a counterpart to Menelik, Solomon's son by the Queen of Sheba.

sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ ‘and now’ (ይእዜ + -ኒ). ሀበኒ ‘give me’ (imperative of ወሀበ + -ኒ). ወልድከ ‘your son’. ዘኣነግሥ is ዘ- ‘whom’ + the 1cs imperfect of አንገሠ ‘make king’ (the causative of ነግሠ). The extra አ again on four words. ሀገረ ሮምያ ‘city-of Rome’ is the construct (the same Rome as ሮም, here ሮምያ).

sentences.i: for I, for my part, am unable to beget a male child, except for three daughters; I shall give him whichever of my daughters he wishes, and I shall give him my throne, and he and his seed after him will be king in the city of Rome for ever. When King Solomon read this letter he considered, saying: If I withhold my son, he will send to the king of the east, who will give him his own son, and what I have decided will be void;
sentences.n: This unit holds the end of the letter and Solomon's thought; the source has no ። at the join, between እስከ ለዓለም and ወሶበ, so I keep it one unit (about 44 words). ስእንኩ is 1cs of ሰአነ ‘be unable’ with ወሊደ ‘to beget’; ዘእንበለ ፫ አዋልድ ‘except three daughters’ (the numeral ፫ is 3; before the feminine plural አዋልድ the spoken form is probably ሠለስ, śäläs (?), as the glossary entry for ፫ has it for feminine nouns). ወእሁቦ ‘and I give him’ (1cs imperfect). አንበባ is አንበበ ‘read’ + -ā ‘it (f.)’, for the feminine ክርታስ ‘letter, papyrus’ (ለ- marks the object). ኀለየ ‘he thought’. ከላእክዎ is ከልአ ‘withhold’ + ‘him’, most likely the king of Rome, from whom the son is kept (ወልድየ ‘my son’ is then the second object), or else -ዎ anticipates ወልድየ (?); ንጉሠ ሠረቅ ‘king-of east’ (ሠረቀ ‘rise’, so ‘sunrise’); who is meant, and who gives whose son to whom, I read as: the eastern king will give his own son to Baltasar (?). ትበጥል ‘will be void’ (በጥለ ‘be void’ (?)); እንተ መከርኩ ‘that which I counselled / decided’.

sentences.i: He took counsel with his counsellors of the house of Israel and said to them: Since we gave our son and our sons to the land of Ethiopia, and a kingdom for Israel arose there,
sentences.n: መከረ ‘took counsel’; መማክርቲሁ ‘his counsellors’ (plural of መምከር + -ሁ); ዘቤተ እስራኤል ‘of the house-of Israel’ (ቤተ construct). እስመ ‘since, because’. ወሀብነ ‘we gave’; ወልደነ ‘our son’ is Menelik, I take (the earlier chapters of the book), ወደቂቀነ ‘and our sons’ the sons of the elders who went with him to Ethiopia (?). ብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ ‘land-of Ethiopia’. ወኮነ በህየ መንግሥት ‘and there came to be there a kingdom’; the text counts Ethiopia as Israel's second kingdom.

sentences.n: ለሀገረ ሮሜ ‘for the city-of Rome’ (spelled ሮሜ, not ሮምያ). አነሂ ‘I too’ (አነ + -ሂ). እፌንዎ ‘I send him’ (1cs imperfect of ፈነወ + ‘him’); ለአርዳሚስ marks the object with ለ-. The name now appears as አርዳሚስ, not አድራሚ (see unit 12). ወልድየ ዘይንእስ ‘my son who is young’ (ዘ- + ንእሰ ‘be small, young’), taken as the younger of two sons: Solomon's elder son is Menelik, so ‘younger’ is natural here.

sentences.i: And you also, do not reproach me for what I did before in taking your sons; for it will be a vow to God, on account of the fact that the people of Ethiopia came to know his name and became his people;
sentences.n: ወአንትሙኒ ‘and you too’ (አንትሙ + -ኒ). ኢታስተአክዩኒ ‘do not (2mp) ... me’; the verb is አስተአከየ, which I take as ‘reproach, blame’ (?), from the context. በእንተ ዘቀዲሙ ዘነሣእክዎሙ ለደቂቅክሙ ‘on account of what formerly (it was) that I took them, your sons’; the ለ- marks the object. ብፅዐ I read as ‘vow, promise’ (?) (ብፅዓት); ‘blessing’ is the other possible sense. ዘአእመሩ ስሞ ‘that they knew his name’ (አእመረ ‘know’); ወኮንዎ ሕዝቦ ‘and became his people’ (ኮነ + ‘to him’, with ሕዝቦ ‘his people’). The argument is that sending the sons out, as to Ethiopia, spreads the knowledge of God; compare the phrase ‘people of God’ below.

sentences.i: and in the same way the people of Rome too, if we give them our sons, will become the people of God; and for us also a name will be given, in that we are called and named the people of God;
sentences.n: ወከማሁ ‘and likewise’; ሰብአ ሮምኒ ‘men-of Rome too’. ለእመ ‘if’; ወሀብኖሙ ‘we give them’ (perfect with ‘if’); ይከውኑ ‘they will be’; ሕዝበ እግዚኣብሔር ‘people-of God’ (construct). ወለነኒ ‘and for us also’; ይትወሀብ ‘will be given’ (passive imperfect). በተብህሎ ወበተሰምዮ ‘in being called and in being named’, two infinitives of the passive (tä-) stems with በ-. People of God echoes the biblical name of Israel (Hosea 2:23; 1 Peter 2:10) without citing it.

sentences.i: Let the people of Israel take the kingdom of Ethiopia and the kingdom of Rome;
sentences.n: I am uncertain of the form. ነሥኡ is the perfect 3mp (‘they took’); the imperative would be ንሥኡ, so the form itself does not support ‘take!’. ሕዝበ እስራኤል ‘people-of Israel’ can be the (construct) subject: ‘the people of Israel took ...’, a perfect of certainty or purpose after the conditions of unit 23, or a slip for the imperative (?). ወሀቡ in the next unit is either an imperative or a perfect (?). መንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ ‘kingdom-of Ethiopia’ and መንግሥተ ሮምያ ‘kingdom-of Rome’ are constructs. A second possibility is that ሕዝበ እስራኤል is a vocative, ‘O people of Israel’ (the accusative-like construct), with ነሥኡ an imperative in perfect vowelling: that would fit the 2mp ወሀቡ and ደቂቅክሙ ‘your sons’ that follow, and the whole speech being addressed to the elders (?). I give the sense of the sentence (Israel's reach over both realms) with a hortatory ‘let’.

sentences.n: ማእከላውያን is ‘those in the middle’ (the middle generation), with -ሰ ‘but’; ይቁሙ ‘let them stand / stay’ (jussive of ቆመ); ውስተ ሀገርነ ‘in our city’. sentences.i: He was pleased with this counsel and did for them as they wished, and he appointed Adrami his son, and took nobles of the house of Israel from among the lowlier ones; and the wood (?) found him in the name of his father Solomon; and they gave him a priest from the tribe of the Levites, whose name was Akimihel, and mounted him on the king's mule, and said to him: Bah! May the father of the king live (?);
sentences.n: A long unit (36 words), unbroken in the source. ወሠምረ ‘he was pleased’; በከመ ፈቀዲ ‘as ... wished’, with ፈቀዲ perhaps ፈቀዱ ‘they wished’ (?). ሤሞ is ሤመ ‘appoint’ + ‘him’; ለአድራሚ marks the object. ወረከቦ ዕፅ በስመ አቡሁ ሰሎሞን is unclear: ረከበ ‘find, receive’ + ‘him’ with ዕፅ ‘wood’; as in ch. 70 I keep ‘wood’ and ‘found him in the name of his father’ and do not turn it into a sceptre (?). ዘስሙ አኪሚሔል ‘whose name Akimihel’ (Bezold; I cannot identify the priest). አጽዐንዎ ‘they mounted him’ (the causative of ጸዐነ / ጽዕነ ‘load, ride’: ‘made him ride’ (?)); በቅለ ንጉሥ ‘mule-of king’, and the mounting of the new king on the royal mule follows 1 Kings 1:33. ባሕ is unclear to me (?). ሕያው አበ ነጋሢ ‘living, father-of king’ (ነጋሢ is the singular ‘king’) is a cry of acclamation, read as a wish ‘may the king’s father (Solomon) live’ as in ch. 70; the exact sense is uncertain (?).

sentences.n: ወእምዝ ‘and after this’; ፈቀደ ያመክሮ ‘he wished that he test him’ (the subject is Baltasar, the object Adrami); በውስተ ፍትሕ ‘in the midst of judgment’. ባዕለ ዐጸደ ወይን ‘owner-of vineyard’, literally ‘lord of the enclosure of wine’ (ዐጸድ ‘enclosure, garden’). ከልሐ ‘cried out’. ተዐደወኒ ቃልከ is obscure; ተዐደወ ‘transgress, be passed over’, so ‘your word (your decree) has been trespassed against me’ (?). አኅለቀ ‘destroyed’; አርሳኒ ወልደ ዮዳድ ‘Arsani, son-of Yodad’ (names as spelled by Bezold, unknown to me (?)). sentences.i: The owner of the sheep answered and said: No, my lord; it ate it only when the tendril had put forth blossom (?).
sentences.n: አልቦ እግዚእየ ‘there is not, my lord’, i.e. ‘no, my lord’. ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ በልዐ ‘except it be (that) the ቆዐ put forth blossom, it ate’; ሠርጸ ‘put forth, sprout’; ጽጌ ‘flower, blossom’. I read it as: the sheep ate the tendril only once it had flowered (?), which I leave as literal as the Geʿez allows, the construction being unusual (?). The part ends here, in the middle of the case, with the verdict still to come; the six ፨ marks close the chapter in Bezold and stay with this last unit.

glossary.በኀይሉ: ኀይል — in his might (በ- + noun + -u '3ms his')
glossary.በአምሳለ: አምሳል — in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct አምሳለ)
glossary.በአባግዒሁ: በግዕ — with his sheep (በ- + plural አባግዕ + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በየማኑ: የማን — at his right hand (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ባልጠሶር: በልጠሶር — Baltasar (proper name; Bezold's spelling ባልጠሶር, beside በልጠሶር and በልጣሶር)
glossary.ባሕ: ባሕ — unidentified; apparently an interjection of greeting before ሕየው (?)
glossary.ባረክዎ: ባረከ — they blessed him (3mp perfect, b-r-k + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ባዕደ: ባዕድ — other, foreign (adjective, accusative masc. sg., agreeing with አማልክተ)
glossary.ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, much (adjective, masc. sg., accusative)
glossary.ብፅዐ: ብፅዓት — vow, promise (?) (noun, accusative; the usual form ends in -ት, which is missing here; ብፅዕ 'blessed, blessedness' is the other possible reading) (?)
glossary.ተባዕተ: ተባዕት — male (adjective/noun, accusative; ተባዕተ ውሉደ 'male sons')
glossary.ተዋቀሱ: ተዋቀሰ — dispute, plead with each other! (2mp imperative, tä-stem, w-q-s) (?) · they disputed (3mp perfect)
glossary.ተዐደወኒ: ተዐደወ — has been transgressed (against) me (3ms perfect, tä-stem, ʿ-d-w + -ኒ '1cs me') (?)
glossary.ትልህቅ: ልህቀ — who grows great, is the elder (3fs imperfect, G, l-h-q, after እንተ) (?)
glossary.ትፈልስ: ፈለሰ — it will migrate, pass over (3fs imperfect, G, f-l-s)
glossary.ትፈትሕ: ፈትሐ — you judge, you decide (2ms imperfect, G, f-t-ḥ)
glossary.ኀለየ: ኀለየ — he thought, reflected (3ms perfect, ḫ-l-y)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
glossary.ኀቤሆሙ: ኀበ — to them (preposition ኀበ, stem ኀቤ- + -ሆሙ '3mp')
glossary.ነሣእከ: ነሥአ — you took (2ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነሥኡ: ነሥአ — they took, received (3mp perfect) · take! / let them take (?) (the vowelling is that of the 3mp perfect, but the sense seems imperative or hortative, cf. ንሥኡ; ሕዝበ እስራኤል may then be a vocative; ነሥኡ መንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ ... ሕዝበ እስራኤል) (?)
glossary.ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of')
glossary.ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53)
glossary.ነገደ: ነገድ — tribe, clan (noun; construct 'tribes of', accusative)
glossary.ነግሡ: ነግሠ — they reigned (3mp perfect, G, n-g-ś)
glossary.ንሣእአ: ነሥአ — take! (2ms imperative ንሣእ with a stray final -አ, a spelling habit of this chapter, not a morpheme)
glossary.ንንግርክሙ: ነገረ — we tell you, that we tell you (1cp jussive/subjunctive ንንግር, G, n-g-r + -ክሙ '2mp you') (?)
glossary.ንንግሮ: ነገረ — let us tell him (1cp jussive, G, n-g-r + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ንዌጥን: ወጠነ — we begin (1cp imperfect or jussive, G, w-ṭ-n)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
glossary.አህጒረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative / construct, here spelled አህጒረ)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አሐተ: አሐዱ — one (numeral, fem. accusative; አሐተ ብእሲተ 'one woman')
glossary.አሕሩጊሁ: ሐረግ — its runners, creepers (?) (noun, plural + -ሁ '3ms its'; connection with ሐረግ uncertain) (?)
glossary.አማንኑ: አማን — in truth? (adverb አማን 'truly' + question particle -ኑ)
glossary.አርሳኒ: አርሳኒ — Arsani (proper name, Bezold's spelling; unidentified) (?)
glossary.አስምዑኒ: አስምዐ — let me hear (2mp imperative, causative of ሰምዐ, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.አስተርአዮ: አስተርአየ — it appeared to him (3ms perfect + -ዮ 'to him')
glossary.አስጠሎባ: አስጠሎባ — astrolabe (?) (noun, apparently from Greek astrolabos; dependent on the construct መጽሐፈ)
glossary.አባግዕኒ: በግዕ — sheep too (plural አባግዕ + enclitic -ኒ; ባዕለ አባግዕኒ 'the owner of the sheep too')
glossary.አኀዝኩ: አኀዘ — I seized, took hold of (1cs perfect, G, ʾ-ḫ-z)
glossary.አንሰ: አነ — as for me (1cs pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.አንበባ: አንበበ — he read it (3ms perfect, causative-stem, n-b-b + -ā '3fs it', anticipating the feminine ክርታስ)
glossary.አኪሚሔል: አኪሚሔል — Akimihel (proper name of a priest, Bezold's spelling; unidentified) (?)
glossary.አዋልድ: ወለት — daughters (noun, plural አዋልድ of ወለት)
glossary.አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.አዕጹቀ: ዕፅ — branches (noun, plural አዕጹቅ, accusative / construct; the lemma ዕፅ 'wood, tree' is taken from the sense) (?)
glossary.አዕጹቂሁ: ዕፅ — its branches (plural አዕጹቅ + -ሁ '3ms its'; lemma ዕፅ taken from the sense) (?)
glossary.አዘዝዎ: አዘዘ — they commanded him (3mp perfect, G, ʾ-z-z + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.አድሎንያ: አድሎንያ — Adlonia (proper name of a woman, Bezold's spelling; unidentified) (?)
glossary.አድራሚ: አድራሚ — Adrami (?) (name of a son of Solomon (?); form obscure, possibly corrupt) (?) · Adrami, Ardamis (proper name; Solomon's younger son by the daughter of the Roman sage; Bezold gives also አርዳሚስ)
glossary.አግብእ: አግብአ — give back, bring back (2ms imperative, causative of ገብአ)
glossary.አፍቀርከ: አፍቀረ — you loved (2ms perfect, causative-stem, ʾ-f-q-r)
glossary.ኢታስተአክዩኒ: አስተአከየ — do not reproach me (ኢ- + 2mp jussive, astä-stem, + -ኒ '1cs me'; sense 'reproach, blame' from context) (?)
glossary.ኢትነብር: ነበረ — she does not stay, dwell (ኢ- + 3fs imperfect, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ኢያምልክ: አምለከ — that he not worship (ኢ- + 3ms jussive, denominative of አምላክ 'god', ʾ-m-l-k)
glossary.ኢይንግሡ: ነግሠ — that they not reign (ኢ- + 3mp jussive, G, n-g-š)
glossary.እሁቦ: ወሀበ — I will give him (1cs imperfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.እምነገደ: ነገድ — from the tribe of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምአዋልድየ: ወለት — from my daughters (እም- 'from' + plural አዋልድ + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun) · from among those who, of those who (እም- partitive; ፩ እምእለ ይቴሐቱ 'one of those who are humbled')
glossary.እምእደ: እድ — from the hand of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምዘርአ: ዘርእ — from the seed of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምጒንዲ: ጒንድ — from the stock, trunk (እም- + noun; Bezold's spelling ጒንዲ)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እግዚእየ: እግዚእ — my lord (noun + -የ '1cs my') · vocative 'my lord' (ብቊዐኒ እግዚእየ) · in apposition, 'David, my lord' (አቡየ ዳዊት እግዚእየ)
glossary.እፌንዎ: ፈነወ — I send him, I will send him (1cs imperfect, G, f-n-w + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ከላእክዎ: ከልአ — I withhold, hold back (something from) him (1cs perfect, G, k-l-ʾ + -ዎ '3ms him'; the suffix may be the one kept from the thing, or may anticipate the object; after ለእመ 'if') (?)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ካህነ: ካህን — priest (noun, accusative, predicate after ይኩንከ)
glossary.ክርታስ: ክርታስ — letter, document, papyrus (noun, here fem.)
glossary.ክብርት: ክቡር — honored (adjective, fem. ክብርት; apposition to the daughter of Zion)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine')
glossary.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ)
glossary.ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወሀቡ: ወሀበ — and give! (ወ- + 2mp imperative ሀቡ, G, w-h-b) · or and they gave (3mp perfect) (?)
glossary.ወሀብነ: ወሀበ — we gave (1cp perfect, G, w-h-b)
glossary.ወሀብኖሙ: ወሀበ — we give them (1cp perfect, G, w-h-b + -ሙ '3mp them'; after ለእመ 'if')
glossary.ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object) · with the -ኦ anticipating a ለ- phrase (ወሀቦ ለወልዱ 'he gave him, to his son') · give him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ሀብ + -ኦ '3ms him', ወሀቦ ወለተከ 'give him your daughter')
glossary.ወለተከ: ወለት — your daughter (noun, accusative + -ከ '2ms your'; the initial ወ belongs to the stem, not 'and')
glossary.ወለትየ: ወለት — my daughter (noun, fem., accusative + -የ '1cs my'; the initial ወ belongs to the stem, not 'and')
glossary.ወለቶ: ወለት — his daughter (noun, accusative + -ቶ '3ms his'; the initial ወ belongs to the stem, not 'and')
glossary.ወለነኒ: ለ — and as for us too (ወ- + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለአከ: ለአከ — and he sent (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወለአኩ: ለአከ — and I sent (ወ- + 1cs perfect, G, l-ʾ-k)
glossary.ወለጥበብከ: ጥበብ — and to your wisdom (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወሊደ: ወለደ — to beget (infinitive / verbal noun, accusative, w-l-d; after ሰአነ 'be unable')
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወልድከአ: ወልድ — your son (noun, accusative + -ከ '2ms your'; stray final -አ, a spelling habit of this chapter)
glossary.ወልዶ: ወልድ — his son (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted)
glossary.ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወመንግሥተ: መንግሥት — and the kingdom (ወ- + noun; accusative)
glossary.ወመንግሥቱ: መንግሥት — and his kingdom (ወ- + noun + -u '3ms his')
glossary.ወመከረ: መከረ — and he took counsel (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወመከሩ: መከረ — and they took counsel (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, m-k-r)

glossary.ወሤሞ: ሤመ — and he appointed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ś-y-m + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወረሰየ: ረሰየ — and he made, set (ወ- + 3ms perfect, r-s-y)
glossary.ወረከቦ: ረከበ — and he found him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ዎ 'him') · the object suffix is -ኦ 'him' (ረከበ + ኦ, contracted -ቦ), not -ዎ
glossary.ወሮምያ: ሮምያ — and Rome (ወ- + proper name, variant of ሮም)
glossary.ወሰመዮ: ሰመየ — and he named him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-m-y + -ዮ 'him')
glossary.ወቀብእዎ: ቀብአ — and they anointed him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, q-b-ʾ + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወበተሰምዮ: ተሰምየ — and in being named (ወ- + በ- + infinitive of the tä-stem ተሰምየ 'be named')
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበጽሑ: በጽሐ — and they arrived (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወበፀጋሙ: ፀጋም — and at his left hand (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted -ሙ)
glossary.ወባረክዎ: ባረከ — and they blessed him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, b-r-k + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወባረኮ: ባረከ — and he blessed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወባርቶንያ: ባርቶንያ — and Bartonia (ወ- + proper name of a city, unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — and they arose (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተዋቀሱ: ተዋቀሰ — and they disputed, pleaded (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተፈሥሐ: ተፈሥሐ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወትበጥል: በጥለ — and it will be void, be annulled (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, b-ṭ-l) (?)
glossary.ወትእዛዘኒ: ትእዛዝ — and as for the commandments (ወ- + noun, accusative + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወኀጥአ: ኀጥአ — and he lacked (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ḫ-ṭ-ʾ; 'lack' taken from context, the usual sense being 'err, sin') (?)
glossary.ወነሥአ: ነሥአ — and he took (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and he took her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወነዋ: ነዋ — and behold, here is (ወ- + interjection ነዋ)
glossary.ወነገርዎ: ነገረ — and they told him (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, G + -ዎ 3ms object)
glossary.ወነግሠ: ነግሠ — and he reigned (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
glossary.ወአምሐልዎ: አምሐለ — and they made him swear (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአስተፋነውዎ: አስተፋነወ — and they sent him off, escorted him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, astä-stem of ፈነወ + -ዎ '3ms him'; 'escort' from context) (?)
glossary.ወአኅለቀ: አኅለቀ — and he destroyed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, ḫ-l-q)
glossary.ወአነሂ: አነ — and I too (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also, indeed')
glossary.ወአንትሙኒ: አንትሙ — and you too (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአንግሦ: አንገሠ — and make him king (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative of ነግሠ, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአወፈይዎ: አወፈየ — and they presented him, brought him forward (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative + -ዎ '3ms him'; 'present' taken from context) (?)
glossary.ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.ወአውሥኦ: አውሥአ — and he answered him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአዘዝዎ: አዘዘ — and they commanded him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ʾ-z-z + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአጽዐንዎ: አጽዐነ — and they mounted him (ወ- + causative 3mp perf. of ጸዐነ 'load, mount' with suffix 3ms -ዎ)
glossary.ወኢያትረፈ: አትረፈ — and he did not leave over (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ተርፈ)
glossary.ወእሁቦ: ወሀበ — and I give him (ወ- 'and' + 1cs imperfect + -ሁ '3ms him', G, w-h-b)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእምአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and from then, from that time (ወ- + እም- 'from' + adverb 'then')
glossary.ወእምዳርዮስ: ዳርዮስ — and from Darius (ወ- + እም- 'from' + proper name)
glossary.ወከልሐ: ከልሐ — and he cried out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, k-l-ḥ)
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — and two (ወ- + numeral, the short form ክልኤ; ዓሥሩ ወክልኤ 'ten and two', twelve)
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወኮንዎ: ኮነ — and they became to him, became his (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, k-w-n + -ዎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወወሀብዎ: ወሀበ — and they gave him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወወለደ: ወለደ — and he begot (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-l-d)
glossary.ወዘረከብነ: ረከበ — and what we found (ወ- + ዘ- + 1cp perfect, G, r-k-b)
glossary.ወዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and his seed (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', ዘርኡ)
glossary.ወዘይቤለክሙ: ብህለ — and what he says (said) to you (ወ- + ዘ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l, used of what is regularly said + -ለክሙ 'to you pl.')
glossary.ወዝንቱሰ: ዝንቱ — and this one indeed (ወ- + m. demonstrative + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወይሁቦ: ወሀበ — and he will give him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect ይሁብ, G, w-h-b + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወይቀንእ: ቀንአ — and he is jealous (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, q-n-ʾ; narrative imperfect)
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይትኤዘዙ: ተኤዘዘ — and they will be obedient (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem of አዘዘ)
glossary.ወይነብሩ: ነበረ — and they would dwell (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, n-b-r; habitual)
glossary.ወይኑ: ወይን — his vine, his wine (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; ዐጸደ ወይኑ 'the enclosure of his vine', his vineyard)
glossary.ወይንየ: ወይን — my vine, my wine (noun + -የ '1cs my'; ወይን is both 'vine' and 'wine', and ዐጸደ ወይንየ 'the enclosure of my vine' is a vineyard)
glossary.ወይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — and now, as for (ወ- 'and' + adverb 'now' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ 'as for, but')
glossary.ወይእዜኒአ: ይእዜ — and now (ወ- + adverb + enclitic -ኒ; stray final -አ, a spelling habit of this chapter)
glossary.ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
glossary.ወይግበር: ገብረ — and let him do (ወ- + 3ms jussive, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወደቂቀነ: ደቂቅ — and our sons (ወ- + plural ደቂቅ, accusative + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወዲርስያ: ዲርስያ — and Dirsia (ወ- + proper name of a city, unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወድኅነሂ: ድኅነ — and he was also saved, delivered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, d-ḫ-n + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወገብኡ: ገብአ — and they returned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form)
glossary.ዐጸደ: ዐጸድ — enclosure, pen, courtyard (noun; construct 'pen of')
glossary.ዓሥሩ: ዐሥሩ — ten (numeral, feminine form; the masculine is ዐሠርቱ; spelled ዓሥሩ here; ዓሥሩ ወክልኤ 'ten and two', twelve)
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
glossary.ዕፍረተ: ዕፍረት — perfume, ointment (noun, fem.; construct 'perfume of')
glossary.ዘለአኮሙ: ለአከ — that he sent them (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, l-ʾ-k + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘርኢነ: ርእየ — what we saw, that which we saw (ዘ- + 1cp perfect, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ዘሰማዕነ: ሰምዐ — what we heard, that which we heard (ዘ- + 1cp perfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘቀዲሙ: ቀዲሙ — what (was) before, formerly (ዘ- 'that which' + adverb ቀዲሙ 'before, formerly')
glossary.ዘቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')
glossary.ዘቦአ: ቦአ — that (it) entered (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ዘትብሉ: ብህለ — what you say (ዘ- + 2mp imperfect, b-h-l)
glossary.ዘነሣእክዎሙ: ነሥአ — that I took them (ዘ- + 1cs perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ዘንበሬስ: ዘንበሬስ — Zenberes (proper name of a man, Bezold's spelling; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ዘአእመሩ: አእመረ — that they knew (ዘ- + 3mp perfect, causative, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ዘኣነግሥአ: አንገሠ — whom I shall make king (ዘ- + 1cs imperfect, causative of ነግሠ; stray final -አ, a spelling habit of this chapter)
glossary.ዘእምአዝማዲሁ: ዘመድ — who (is) of his kinsmen (ዘ- + እም- 'of, from' + plural አዝማድ of ዘመድ 'kinsman' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
glossary.ዘይነግሥ: ነግሠ — who reigns (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘይንእስ: ንእሰ — who is younger, small (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, n-ʾ-s)
glossary.ዘደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — what is later, the future (ዘ- 'that which' + adjective 'last, later')
glossary.ዘፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — what he wished (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.የዐቅቡ: ዐቀበ — who keep (3mp imperfect, G, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.የዐብያ: ዐበየ — which are great, which surpass (3fp imperfect, G, ʿ-b-y, after እለ) (?)
glossary.ያመክሮ: አመከረ — that he test him (3ms subjunctive, causative, ʾ-m-k-r + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ይልእክ: ለአከ — he sends, he sent (3ms imperfect, G; narrative habitual 'he would send')
glossary.ይቁሙ: ቆመ — let them stand, stay (3mp jussive, G, q-w-m)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይቴሐቱ: ተሐተ — they are humbled, lowly (3mp imperfect; the stem ተሐተ 'be low, humbled') (?)
glossary.ይትወሀብ: ተውህበ — is given (3ms imperfect passive of ወሀበ)
glossary.ይነሥኦን: ነሥአ — he takes them (3ms imperfect, G, n-ś-ʾ + -ኦን '3fp them (f.)')
glossary.ይነብሩ: ነበረ — they live, dwell (3mp imperfect, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ይከውኑ: ኮነ — they will be (3mp imperfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
glossary.ይዕቀብ: ዐቀበ — that he keep (G 3ms subjunctive, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ይደልዎ: ደለወ — it befits him (G 3ms imperf. ይደሉ + ሎ 'to him', written ይደልዎ; d-l-w)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ደቂቅነ: ደቂቅ — our sons (plural noun + -ነ '1cp our') · 'our children' (ደቂቅ plural 'children' + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ደቂቅክሙ: ደቂቅ — your sons (plural noun, plural of ወልድ + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገበርኩ: ገብረ — I did, I made (1cs perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-) · his servant (ገብር + -ሁ '3ms his', ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant') · they made (3mp perfect of ገብረ, G, g-b-r; ገብሩ አህጉረ 'they made cities')
glossary.ጒንዲ: ጒንድ — stock, trunk (noun; Bezold's spelling ጒንዲ)
glossary.ጥበቢሁ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his'; the suffix anticipates the possessor named with ለ-) · plain 'his wisdom' with no ለ- phrase following (ከመ ትስማዕ ጥበቢሁ 'that she may hear his wisdom')
glossary.ጽሑፈ: ጽሑፍ — written (passive participle, masc. sg., accusative)
glossary.ጽሑፋን: ጽሑፍ — written (passive participle, plural ጽሑፋን, agreeing with ጽላት)
glossary.ጽሒፎ: ጸሐፈ — written, in writing (gerund ጽሒፎ, ṣ-ḥ-f; 'having written')
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፈቀዲ: ፈቀደ — they wished (3mp perfect, G, f-q-d; spelled ፈቀዲ for ፈቀዱ) (?)
glossary.ፈቀድከ: ፈቀደ — you wished, desired (2ms perfect, G)
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine · after a noun, 'third' (ወልድከ ፫ 'your third son'), the spoken ordinal ሣልስ (śalləs) (?)
glossary.፲ወ፰: ፲ወ፰ — 18, spoken ዐሠርቱ ወሰመንቱ (ʿäśärtu wä-sämäntu) 'ten and eight'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፸፪: ሰብዓ ወክልኤ — numeral 72, spoken ሰብዓ ወክልኤ (säbʿa wä-kəlʾe) 'seventy-two' (numeral, Ethiopic digits ፸ 70 + ፪ 2)
